method: Collocated accelerometer + FMCW mmWave radar; automated best-target and LOS-to-structure conversion calibration; accelerometer-aided phase unwrapping; FIR fusion of radar displacement and acceleration.
quote: Automated initial calibration ... best target ... conversion factor ... accelerometer-aided phase-unwrapping ... fused ... using a finite impulse response filter.
transfer_limit: Requires collocated/synchronized acceleration and radar, stable reflector, and recalibration of geometry; FIR introduces short delay and acceleration drift remains a boundary.
notes: Local full text was extracted from the author-hosted PDF; do not infer broader deployment claims.

method: Discrete constant-acceleration Kalman state [phase, phase-rate], acceleration-aided prediction, predictive 2pi correction, recursive update, energy-based Q optimization, and acceleration-phase direction-factor fit.
quote: The phase is modeled as a one-dimensional constant-acceleration system ... predictive-based correction ... recursive ... continuous and noise-suppressed phase trajectory.
transfer_limit: Needs synchronized same-direction acceleration, wavelength and direction-factor calibration, and retuning Q/R; validation is structural vibration only.
notes: Equations (6)-(19) were checked in local extracted full text.

method: Multi-chirp adaptive phase unwrapping: estimate phase-change rate per time step, predict next phase, and use predicted range for integer-cycle recovery without ad-hoc thresholds or extra sensors.
quote: A novel multi-chirp-based algorithm ... estimates the phase change rate using multi-chirps ... predicts the phase for the next time step ... reference phase range for phase unwrapping.
transfer_limit: Abstract-level only; chirp configuration, equations, and failure handling remain unverified. Results are laboratory/footbridge structural displacement.
notes: Do not label as local full text.

method: Modified FMCW radar phase extraction for bridge displacement, inclinometer-based radar elevation correction, and multi-point displacement-profile detection.
quote: Phase information extraction ... radar elevation detection based on an inclinometer ... multi-point detection ... capture the displacement profile over bridge span.
transfer_limit: Only a secondary reproduction of the abstract; full equations, filtering and unwrap details unavailable. Geometry correction requires inclinometer/installation information.
notes: IEEE record is closed; keep evidence level below publisher full text.

method: Three-axis MEMS accelerometer + 60 GHz FMCW radar phase fusion; automated target selection and LOS conversion; adaptive acceleration-aided unwrap; FIR fusion.
quote: The sensor integrates ... three-axis MEMS accelerometer and phase-shift measurements ... automated best-target selection ... adaptive phase-unwrapping ... combined ... using a finite impulse response (FIR) filter.
transfer_limit: Proceedings/structural-model evidence; claimed RCB deployment and sub-0.1 mm resolution are not field-wide guarantees.
notes: PDF downloaded from the proceedings page and text-extracted locally.

method: Occlusion-aware multi-target radar/accelerometer fusion: target selection and direction factors, acceleration-aided unwrap while visible, target switching, acceleration reconstruction during full occlusion, and multi-target absolute unwrap after recovery.
quote: A displacement reconstruction algorithm was proposed for target occlusion periods, and a multitarget-based phase-unwrapping algorithm ... remove displacement drift caused by radar target occlusion.
transfer_limit: Abstract-level evidence; requires multiple stable targets, occlusion detection and acceleration reconstruction. Do not generalize reported <0.1 mm to other scenes.
notes: Publisher page exposes abstract/highlights but not an accessible local PDF.
